# prismasdwan_ipfix_template (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of Prisma SD-WAN Ipfix Template items.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Palo Alto Networks Inc. 2025
#
# Sample data source example for "ipfix_template".
# This file is generated - do not edit by hand.
#
# Before using this example, configure the Prisma SD-WAN provider:
#
#   terraform {
#     required_providers {
#       prismasdwan = {
#         source  = "paloaltonetworks/prismasdwan"
#       }
#     }
#   }
#
#   provider "prismasdwan" {
#     host          = "api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com"
#     client_id     = "acmeuser@12345.iam.panserviceaccount.com"
#     client_secret = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
#     scope         = "tsg_id:12345"
#     auth_url      = "https://auth.apps.paloaltonetworks.com/am/oauth2/access_token"
#   }

data "prismasdwan_ipfix_template" "example" {
  # Select an item by matching one or more of its attributes.
  filters = {
    name = "example_name"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filters` (Map of String) Path parameters used to locate the items to retrieve.

### Optional

- `x_etag` (Number) Entity tag returned by the API, managed automatically by the provider.
- `x_parameters` (Map of String) Additional path parameters for the data source, managed automatically by the provider.
- `x_schema` (Number) Schema version returned by the API, managed automatically by the provider.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The list of items returned by the data source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `flow_fields` (List of String) Flow fields. Each item: one of INTERFACES, TIME_STAMPS, DST_IPV4_ADDRESS, DST_PORT, SRC_IPV4_ADDRESS, SRC_PORT, PROTOCOL, DSCP_MAP, DSCP_LAST, QOS_QUEUE, WAN_PATH, APP_DEF_ID, RTP_TRANSPORT_TYPE, TRANSPORT_TCP_WINDOWSIZE, CONNECTION_UNIFLOW_BYTES, CONNECTION_UNIFLOW_PACKETS, CONNECTION_BIFLOW_BYTES, CONNECTION_BIFLOW_PACKETS, CONNECTION_RTT, CONNECTION_NTT, CONNECTION_SRT, APPLICATION_HOST, CONNECTION_INIT, CONNECTION_XACT, CONNECTION_UDPTRT, MEDIA_CODEC, MEDIA_JITTER, MEDIA_LOSS, MEDIA_MOS, TROUBLESHOOT_TCP, TROUBLESHOOT_DECISION_MAP, VRF_NAME.
- `generate_biflow` (Boolean) Generate biflow.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object, assigned by the API. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `option_export_timeout` (Number) Option export timeout.
- `options` (List of String) Options. Each item: one of APP_DEF_ID_TABLE, LINK_QUALITY_METRICS, WAN_PATH_ID_TABLE, TYPE_INFO_FOR_IPFIX_IE, DEVICE_IDENTIFICATION.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags.
- `template_export_timeout` (Number) Template export timeout.
- `x_etag` (Number) Etag for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `x_schema` (Number) Schema version for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
